title: Olympian Chemmy Alcott Injured in Lake Stunt
summary: Olympian Chemmy Alcott suffered a collapsed lung after a failed front flip into a lake. The 44-year-old landed awkwardly, resulting in the injury. Alcott, a BBC star, shared a photo of a bloody chest drain after the incident. The photo showed the severity of the injury. Alcott's condition is not specified beyond the collapsed lung.
summary_points: Olympian Chemmy Alcott suffered a collapsed lung
The injury occurred after a failed front flip into a lake
Alcott landed awkwardly, causing the lung to collapse
A photo of a bloody chest drain was shared by Alcott
The incident involved a 44-year-old Olympian and BBC star
title_hi: ओलंपियन केमी अल्कॉट लेक प्रदर्शन में घायल
